tools.lang_desc: Change the interface language. Your choice is remembered.
tools.ss_desc: Scraping works out of the box (built-in software credentials). Optional: your member account for quota boost. Stored locally in screenscraper_config.json.
tools.ss_threads_max: ScreenScraper allows {n} threads for your account. This setting can only lower that number.
tools.ss_threads_unknown: Without a member account, or before ScreenScraper's first answer: 1 thread. This setting can only lower the allowed number.
tools.ss_cache: Keep ScreenScraper answers in a cache
tools.ss_cache_hint: Rescraping a game already found then uses no request from your quota. "Game not found" is only kept for one day.

scrape.choose_info: “{search}”: {n} possible results. Pick the right one.
scrape.nothing_new: Nothing new: the game already has everything {source} offers.
scrape.preset_missing_title: Tick only what the game is missing
scrape.preset_all_title: Also tick what replaces an existing value or file
scrape.hint: What is missing is ticked; nothing is replaced unless you say so.
scrape.from_cache: Cached answer from {date}: no request sent to ScreenScraper.

server.ss_empty_gameid: Empty ScreenScraper response for this gameid
server.ss_not_found: No game found on ScreenScraper for this ROM / name
server.ss_candidates: Several possible games — pick the right one from the list.
server.ss_dev_ok: Developer credentials OK (no member account → base quotas)
server.ss_429: Too many requests to ScreenScraper (HTTP 429). Wait 30–60 seconds before retrying.
server.ss_503: ScreenScraper temporarily unavailable (HTTP 503). Try again later.
server.ss_login: ScreenScraper credentials rejected. If you use boost, check ssid/password in Tools.
server.ss_api_closed: ScreenScraper API temporarily closed. Try again later.
server.ss_quota: ScreenScraper quota or thread limit reached. Wait a bit, or enable a member account (boost) in Tools for higher limits.
server.ss_too_many: Too many ScreenScraper requests. Wait before retrying (the app already spaces calls).
server.adb_503: Arcade Database under maintenance or overloaded (HTTP 503). Try again in a few minutes.
server.adb_rate: Arcade Database rate limit reached. Wait a moment (one request stream per IP is recommended).
server.adb_no_romset: Cannot determine ROM name (path missing in XML)
server.adb_romset_missing: Romset “{romset}” not found on Arcade Database
server.adb_not_found: No Arcade Database game for romset “{romset}” (folder: {folder}). ADB is designed for MAME/FBNeo names.
server.no_gamelist: No gamelist.xml loaded — open a file via “Gamelist…”.
server.steam_candidates: Several Steam matches — pick the right one.
server.steam_too_large: Steam video too large (50 MB limit)
server.green_placeholder: Empty ScreenScraper boxback (solid green image ignored).
server.mame_xml_missing: No mame.xml found. Put a « mame.exe -listxml > mame.xml » dump next to the gamelist, in emulators/mame/ or bios/mame/.
server.mame_xml_empty: mame.xml has no usable machine/game entries.
server.stale_game: This game changed in gamelist.xml (edited outside the app). The list has been reloaded: check the selection and try again.
server.rom_not_deleted: Could not delete {path} ({detail}). Nothing was changed.
server.source_timeout: {source} did not answer in time: the server may be overloaded.
server.stale_gamelist: The active gamelist has changed. Reload the list before continuing.
server.image_unreadable: unreadable or corrupt image, not saved
server.image_too_small: image too small ({w}×{h} px), not saved
server.image_uniform: single-colour or empty image, not saved
server.ss_busy: ScreenScraper is overloaded and refuses non-members for now (HTTP 401). Try again in a few minutes, or add your member account in Settings.
server.ss_blacklisted: ScreenScraper refuses this version of the software (HTTP 426). Update Gamelist Media Editor.
server.ss_quota_day: ScreenScraper daily quota reached (HTTP 430). Try again tomorrow.
server.ss_quota_ko: Too many unrecognised ROMs today (HTTP 431, ScreenScraper quota). Sort out your ROMs and try again tomorrow.

open_gl.title: Open a gamelist.xml
open_gl.intro: Browse to the system folder, select a gamelist.xml, or paste the full path. The images / videos / manuals folders must sit next to it.
open_gl.need_path: Enter the path to the gamelist.xml
open_gl.drop_hint: The browser does not expose the full path of a dropped file — paste the path from Explorer (Shift+right-click → Copy as path).

about.title: About
about.desc: Local web app to edit EmulationStation / RetroBat gamelist.xml media and metadata. Drag-and-drop, ScreenScraper, Arcade Database & Steam scrapers, filters, backups and a multilingual UI.
about.author: Author
about.note: Software provided “as is”. No ROMs are distributed. Scrapers call public ScreenScraper, Arcade Database (Arcade Italia) and Steam services — please use them responsibly.

actions.label: Whole gamelist
actions.backup_sub: Copy gamelist.xml.bak next to the file
actions.export_csv_sub: The games shown in the list, for Excel or LibreOffice

settings.title: Settings
settings.theme_desc: Dark by default. “System” follows the light or dark setting of Windows.
settings.required_desc: A game is complete when it has every required media of its system. The list counter, the “Required media missing” filter and Next incomplete use them.
settings.required_no_system: Open a gamelist to choose the required media of its system.
settings.sources_desc: The Scrape button picks the source for the system: Arcade Database for arcade folders, Steam for steam, ScreenScraper for the others. Another choice made in its menu is remembered here.
settings.sources_none: No forced choice: the source is picked automatically for every system.
settings.keys_desc: Letters do nothing while typing in a field.
settings.key_first_last: First / last game of the list
settings.key_next_incomplete: Next game missing a required media
settings.key_select: Tick the game for the batch scrape (Shift+click: up to this game)
settings.key_close: Close a window or a menu

romcheck.title: Check ROMs
romcheck.action_sub: Compare the gamelist with the files of its folder
romcheck.all_good: The gamelist matches the files of the folder.
romcheck.unlisted_desc: Added with the file name: scrape them afterwards (S, then N for the next one).
romcheck.missing_desc: The file given by <path> no longer exists. Removing the entry takes the game out of the gamelist.
romcheck.missing_warning: More than half of the games have no ROM: check that this is the right folder (disconnected drive?). Nothing is ticked.
romcheck.delete_media: Also delete their media (except those used by another game)
romcheck.duplicates_desc: The same ROM is listed several times. Merging keeps the most complete entry and adds the others' fields to it.
romcheck.more: … and {n} more (they follow the section's box)
romcheck.non_file: {n} entry(ies) without a file (steam://… link) left aside.
romcheck.arcade_note: Arcade system: .chd disks and a romset's folder (kinst/ beside kinst.zip) are not counted as games.

mediacheck.title: Check media
mediacheck.action_sub: Unused media, links to missing files
mediacheck.all_good: Every media file is used and every link points to a file.
mediacheck.orphans_desc: Files in the {folders} folders that no game of the gamelist uses.
mediacheck.orphans_warning: More than half of the media look unused: is this folder shared with another gamelist? Nothing is ticked.
mediacheck.broken_desc: The game's tag points to a file that no longer exists. Removing the tag touches no file.
mediacheck.done: {deleted} media file(s) deleted ({size} freed), {unlinked} link(s) removed
mediacheck.done_failed: · {n} file(s) not deleted (locked, or no Recycle Bin)

batch.title: Scrape in batch
batch.action_sub: The ticked games, else those shown in the list
batch.no_games: No game to scrape: the list is empty.
batch.intro_list: The {n} game(s) shown in the list, with {source} ({system}). Tick games in the list to scrape only some of them.
batch.mode_missing: Only empty fields are filled; nothing is replaced.
batch.mode_all: The ticked fields are also replaced when the source has another value.
batch.uncertain_desc: The source does not recognise the ROM and offers several games: nothing was written. Choose the right game.
batch.errors_desc: Games not found or failed downloads.
batch.updated_desc: The fields written for each game.
batch.claimed: This batch was resumed in another window. Reopen the report to continue.
batch.penalty: ScreenScraper asked to slow down: 1 thread for 2 minutes.
batch.refresh_hint: Asks ScreenScraper again for every game (uses quota) and updates the cache.

backups.title: Backups and restoration
backups.intro: The last 30 XML copies are kept. Restoring does not recover deleted ROMs or media.
backups.empty: No dated backups for this gamelist.
backups.confirm: Restore the XML from {date}? The current XML will be backed up first. ROMs and media stay unchanged.
backups.restored: Gamelist restored. The previous version remains in the backups.

ssmedia.title: ScreenScraper media
ssmedia.desc: For each media: the type asked from ScreenScraper and the region tried first (the other regions follow when the game has none in it). An unticked media is no longer proposed by ScreenScraper, in single or batch scrapes. Wheel and Title screen are new and unticked by default. Auto = the preferred region of the ScreenScraper tab.
ssmedia.music_note: Music: ScreenScraper has no music for games, so it is not scraped. Add an audio file (MP3, OGG, WAV or FLAC) from the editor: it goes to music/ and into the <music> tag (Batocera, RetroBat).
